reason: Fit the gear guards to protect the drive; it is the only offered combination.

effect: The guards complete the rover’s protected drive, and the result points toward adding a pen and driver later.
reaction: The covered gears are a sensible finish, though I was curious to see the rover move.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the wheel drives was most worthwhile: the explanation of steering through different wheel speeds made the simple chassis more interesting.

leastWorthwhile.text: The battery and switch fittings felt repetitive, with little to decide or learn from their results.

surprise.text: I learned that the two driven wheels can steer by running at different speeds, without a steering axle.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, although several sequential fittings were the only offered combination rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would continue to see the rover draw and deliver an invitation; the chassis explanation was interesting, though I hope the next chapter offers more meaningful decisions.
